faq.sectionSubtitle: Quick answers before your next park day.
faq.pageSubtitle: Everything you need to know about the UOR Waiting Time app.

items.question: Is the app free?
items.answer: Yes. UOR Waiting Time is free to download and use. The app is supported by ads, so you may see banner and full-screen ads from time to time.

items.question: Which parks are covered?
items.answer: All four Universal Orlando Resort parks: Universal Studios Florida, Islands of Adventure, Epic Universe, and Volcano Bay.

items.question: Which languages are supported?
items.answer: The app supports English, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese.

items.question: How often is the data updated?
items.answer: Live wait times are refreshed about every 15 minutes while the parks are open, roughly from 7:00 to 23:59 Orlando time. Data may pause when the parks are closed.

items.question: Do I need an internet connection?
items.answer: Yes. An internet connection is required for live wait times, park hours, closures, and the latest attraction information.

items.question: Why does the app differ from the wait sign at the ride?
items.answer: Wait times change constantly. The app refreshes about every 15 minutes, so a small difference from the sign at the entrance is normal. Use it as a guide for planning your route.

items.question: Can I see historical wait trends?
items.answer: Yes. Weekly and monthly trends show typical waits by weekday and by month, and each ride page includes wait history and statistics.

items.question: Does the app include shows, dining, and shops?
items.answer: Yes. You can browse attractions, shows, restaurants, and shops for each park, with search and sorting to narrow the list.

items.question: How do I report a problem or send feedback?
items.answer: Open Settings in the app and choose Feedback to send an email, or write to srcchang@gmail.com directly.
